text: The doctor was lovely, kind, and had a very gentle touch. The staff were also lovely.

I had root canal treatment here. The clinic recommended a specialist and scheduled an appointment immediately. The doctor was incredibly gentle. I've had root canal treatments elsewhere before, and I was always bothered by the anesthetic injection, but this doctor was so gentle I didn't even realize it was over. The procedure itself was very relaxing. At other places, even with anesthetic, I could still feel the pressure being applied in my mouth. The reception staff explained the aftercare clearly and attentively. Since then, I've chosen this clinic for my dental checkups, scaling, and fillings for many years. Their scaling is the gentlest in the world! I also got my new retainer here. The doctor is incredibly polite, gentle, and kind. Each case is handled by a different doctor, but the standard is consistently high: gentle, polite, skilled, and the clinic is spotlessly clean.
